description: Soft-hide an active Slideshow Run from default workspace lists and pickers without deleting slide data or review URLs. Use to declutter the workspace after campaign completion. Do NOT use for permanent destruction; use delete_slideshow_run instead. Idempotent state change, fully reversible via restore_slideshow_run. Preserves all slide records, rendered assets, and external links. Returns updated SlideshowRun with status set to archived.

runId.description: The unique Slideshow Run identifier to archive.
